summary: Actual HH community store, renderer, and public-controller event path passed teacher topic/reply reports, moderator hide/restore, role-projected visibility, stale hidden-topic blocking, and volatile/local-only feedback. Report markers are visible on topics in the moderator index, but no dedicated report queue exists; reply reports are found by opening topics, and restore clears the corresponding reported marker. This is a bounded workflow usability gap, not a failed authorization or recovery invariant.
falsifierOrUsableGap: Usable gap: moderator has no consolidated report queue or reply-report filter; reported replies require opening their parent topic. The probe confirms the existing moderator index/detail controls and recovery behavior.
